newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX to raise Hub natgas futures margins Thursday.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX to raise Hub natgas futures margins Thursday.

text.p: New York Mercantile Exchange said it will increase margins on its Henry Hub natural gas futures contract, effective at the close of business Thursday.
The initial margin will be raised to $3,300 from $2,500 for clearing members; to $3,630 from $2,750 for members, and to $4,455 from $3,375 for customers.
Inter-month spreads involving the spot month will be increased to $1,000 from $500 for clearing members; to $1,100 from $550 for members, and to $1,350 from $675 for customers.
